Net income also rose, bolstered by favorable tax conditions and reduced interest expenses due to a restructuring of long-term debt. The company managed to reduce its financial leverage, leading to an improvement in its interest coverage ratio. Profitability remains strong, operational efficiency is improving, and the company\u2019s balance sheet reflects a stable, low-risk financial structure. function.name: tail

It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Display the last part of a file of any extension. function.name: touch
